label: original-phase steps 3-6 on o/d/1/a/n after q/y/c/1, in sequences starting with p/k (token-conjunction, unexplained)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.02% of steps). It fires almost only in the original phase at steps 3-6 (peak at t=4); it never fires at t<3 or in the copy phase, and fires rarely on the delimiter. The current input is mostly o, d, 1, a or n, and the feature likes it when the previous one or two inputs are q, y, c or 1 and the first token is p or k (also j or b). Each of these factors is only a weak enrichment, and the feature seems to respond to a soft combination of current token, recent history and first token rather than to any single rule. The broad predicate (t in 3..6 and in_tok in {o,d,1,a,n}) covers about 84% of activation mass but has 0.5% precision. Adding the history conditions gives a best F1 of about 0.23 on dev. Magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.21), and the strongest examples combine all the enriched factors, for example k g c 1 1 or k u a t q d.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=k (+4.77), prev_tok=1 (+4.76), orig0=p (+4.65), prev_tok=y (+4.12), prev_tok=q (+4.09), orig0=j (+3.69). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-3.47), phase=2 (-2.59), t=8 (-2.57), t=7 (-2.49).
